mentions.name: Kintoun
mentions.description: This app translates documents, including PowerPoint slides. It is improving translation quality by giving the LLM more context, and it fixes an issue where PowerPoint slide layouts become messy after translation because of the text density difference between western and CJK languages.
mentions.problem: PowerPoint slide layouts can become messy after translation because western and CJK languages have different text density.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Two things for my document translator https://kintoun.ai :

1. Trying to improve the translation quality by giving LLM more context.

2. Fixing the issue where PowerPoint slides layout may become a bit messy after transition because of different text density between western and CJK languages.
